name: Originality
desc: The ability to come up with unusual or clever ideas about a given topic or situation, or to develop creative ways to solve a problem.

name: Mathematical Reasoning
desc: The ability to choose the right mathematical methods or formulas to solve a problem.

name: Spatial Orientation
desc: The ability to know your location in relation to the environment or to know where other objects are in relation to you.

name: Finger Dexterity
desc: The ability to make precisely coordinated movements of the fingers of one or both hands to grasp, manipulate, or assemble very small objects.

name: Wrist-Finger Speed
desc: The ability to make fast, simple, repeated movements of the fingers, hands, and wrists.

name: Stamina
desc: The ability to exert yourself physically over long periods of time without getting winded or out of breath.

name: Far Vision
desc: The ability to see details at a distance.

name: Hearing Sensitivity
desc: The ability to detect or tell the differences between sounds that vary in pitch and loudness.

name: Investigative
desc: Work involves studying and researching non-living objects, living organisms, disease or other forms of impairment, or human behavior. Investigative occupations are often associated with physical, life, medical, or social sciences, and can be found in the field

name: Second Interest High-Point
desc: Secondary-Cutoff/Rank Descriptiveness

name: Writing
desc: Communicating effectively in writing as appropriate for the needs of the audience.

name: Learning Strategies
desc: Selecting and using training/instructional methods and procedures appropriate for the situation when learning or teaching new things.

name: Customer and Personal Service
desc: Knowledge of principles and processes for providing customer and personal services. This includes customer needs assessment, meeting quality standards for services, and evaluation of customer satisfaction.

name: Engineering and Technology
desc: Knowledge of the practical application of engineering science and technology. This includes applying principles, techniques, procedures, and equipment to the design and production of various goods and services.

name: Chemistry
desc: Knowledge of the chemical composition, structure, and properties of substances and of the chemical processes and transformations that they undergo. This includes uses of chemicals and their interactions, danger signs, production techniques, and disposal method

name: Therapy and Counseling
desc: Knowledge of principles, methods, and procedures for diagnosis, treatment, and rehabilitation of physical and mental dysfunctions, and for career counseling and guidance.

name: Philosophy and Theology
desc: Knowledge of different philosophical systems and religions. This includes their basic principles, values, ethics, ways of thinking, customs, practices, and their impact on human culture.

name: Health Care Service
desc: Work involves providing health care services to individuals to include the diagnosis, prevention, or treatment of diseases and other forms of illness or impairment.

name: Marketing/Advertising
desc: Work involves promoting or creating a public image for products, services, or organizations to attract interest, engagement, or sales.

name: Public Speaking
desc: Work involves speaking before an audience to educate, entertain, or influence the listeners.

name: Protective Service
desc: Work involves maintaining order and protecting life and property by conducting investigations and enforcing laws and regulations to prevent or solve crimes.

name: Physical Science
desc: Work involves studying and researching non-living objects, materials, and phenomena through scientific disciplines such as physics, chemistry, astronomy, meteorology, or geology.

name: Information Technology
desc: Work involves designing, developing, testing, and maintaining computer software, hardware, networks, and systems.

name: Media
desc: Work involves producing, developing, writing, directing, or presenting information through print, radio, television, or digital media.

name: On-the-Job Training
desc: Amount of on the job training required to perform the job?

name: Instructing
desc: Teaching others how to do something.

name: Installation
desc: Installing equipment, machines, wiring, or programs to meet specifications.

name: Repairing
desc: Repairing machines or systems using the needed tools.

name: Management of Financial Resources
desc: Determining how money will be spent to get the work done, and accounting for these expenditures.

name: Inspecting Equipment, Structures, or Materials
desc: Inspecting equipment, structures, or materials to identify the cause of errors or other problems or defects.

name: Making Decisions and Solving Problems
desc: Analyzing information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.

name: Performing General Physical Activities
desc: Performing general physical activities includes doing activities that require considerable use of your arms and legs and moving your whole body, such as climbing, lifting, balancing, walking, stooping, and handling materials.

name: Repairing and Maintaining Mechanical Equipment
desc: Servicing, repairing, adjusting, and testing machines, devices, moving parts, and equipment that operate primarily on the basis of mechanical (not electronic) principles.

name: Establishing and Maintaining Interpersonal Relationships
desc: Developing constructive and cooperative working relationships with others, and maintaining them over time.

name: Developing and Building Teams
desc: Encouraging and building mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.

name: Staffing Organizational Units
desc: Recruiting, interviewing, selecting, hiring, and promoting employees in an organization.

name: Face-to-Face Discussions with Individuals and Within Teams
desc: How frequently does your job require face-to-face discussions with individuals and within teams?

name: Work Outcomes and Results of Other Workers
desc: How responsible is the worker for work outcomes and results of other workers?

name: Outdoors, Exposed to All Weather Conditions
desc: How often does this job require working outdoors, exposed to all weather conditions?

name: Exposed to Very Hot or Cold Temperatures
desc: How often does this job require working in very hot (above 90 F degrees) or very cold (below 32 F degrees) temperatures?

name: Exposed to Disease or Infections
desc: How often does this job require exposure to disease/infections?

name: Spend Time Standing
desc: How much does this job require standing?

name: Spend Time Bending or Twisting Your Body
desc: How much does this job require bending or twisting your body?

name: Frequency of Decision Making
desc: How often is the worker required to make decisions that affect other people, the financial resources, and/or the image and reputation of the organization?

name: Level of Competition
desc: To what extent does this job require the worker to compete or to be aware of competitive pressures?

name: Achievement Orientation
desc: A tendency to establish and maintain personally challenging work-related goals, set high work-related standards, and exert high effort toward meeting those goals and standards.

name: Perseverance
desc: A tendency to exhibit determination and resolve to perform or complete tasks in the face of difficult circumstances or obstacles at work.

name: Optimism
desc: A tendency to exhibit a positive attitude and positive emotions at work, even under difficult circumstances.

name: Stress Tolerance
desc: A tendency to cope and function effectively in stressful situations at work.
